items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22

The only ones that I remember is that really were considered good was Fisher's band and my brother's band. And we did if... I'm not bragging, but we did have one of the best bands down here. And that's why when Tom went up there and was so successful, the people were all waiting a block or so to gain admittance. Other cafe owners, they were losing business so fast that they told the unionists, they said, well, you have to do something about that. He said, we... We're losing business. And the fellow says, well,…
Didn't you have some piano roles or something you wanted to ask about?
